teaser: Specialist agents for design, UX, code, security, ABP and writing serve every team, so new ones start from our best work. Expertise you can hire.
core_idea: Long-lived specialist agents, each with a person who owns the skill, compress what we know and consult for every team; the same model lets expertise be hired across companies.

quotes.text: A new team starts from scratch.
It is far more efficient to operate from that compression than to make every team rebuild it.
The expert is paid for judgement; the agent does the volume.

figures.caption: Specialist agents for design, UX, code, security, ABP and writing, serving every team through lanes and reviews.
Expertise that never scaled, now with a team behind it: an expert, their specialist agent, many teams.
